brief: Asks whether a list is a named parameter, a pair such as [ :At, 3 ] whose first item is a keyword of the library.
detail: The library lets a caller pass a value with a keyword, as in Insert(x, [ :After, 2 ]), and each method tells the pair apart with a test. This class holds a list and carries more than 1,300 such tests, one per keyword, named Is<Keyword>NamedParam; they are generated or hand-written one-liners, and only the dozen hand-written ones are described here. For a new test, prefer IsANamedParam (is it any known pair) or IsOneOfTheseNamedParams over adding another method. Build one with new stzListNamedParams(aList) or over a stzList object. Ring keeps symbols in lowercase, so [ :At, 3 ] is stored as [ "at", 3 ]; the comparison ignores case.
